title: Avalanche $AVAX Visa-Powered crypto CARD!
description:
🚀 Welcome to Rypto – Your Ultimate Crypto Hub! 🌐

📈 In this video, In Hong Kong I heard people talking about PayFi set to become a new trend, it seems that's starting.

Avalanche has just launched the Avalanche Card, a Visa-powered crypto payment solution designed for real-world use. Built in partnership with Rain, it allows users to spend AVAX, USDC, USDT, and wAVAX anywhere Visa is accepted without off-ramps or bank restrictions.
This is a major step in bringing crypto to everyday transactions, especially in underbanked regions like Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia, where traditional financial services are limited. With inflation and banking barriers pushing more people toward digital assets, the Avalanche Card offers a seamless, borderless alternative.
Sign-ups are now open.
